Subject: Aligning logistics for client lab day — hybrid rehearsal & AV failover plan

Hi Tom / Priya —

Thanks again for agreeing to the hands-on lab day. To make sure the session is low-friction for your team, I want to align on a few logistics before we lock the calendar: 

What we're proposing
- Hybrid format: preferred in-person + remote observers. We can make it fully remote if needed.
- Block for run-through + 1-hour scripted load rehearsal (prompt review, routing validation, load ramp)

Requests / asks from Lumen Retail
1) Confirm in-person headcount (attendees who need visitor passes).
2) Confirm whether recording is allowed (we can disable recording on request).
3) Any site-specific AV rules (no external streaming allowed, use of company AV switcher, etc.).

Our suggested windows (attachments include a CSV with more slots):
- Thu 19 May, 13:30–16:30 PT (preferred; allows for 14:30 rehearsal + 15:00 load test)
- Fri 20 May, 09:00–12:00 PT (backup)

AV / failover notes (high level)
- Primary: on-site room AV (room PC -> projector, meeting mic).
- Failover: Redwood engineer streams via Zoom + local capture if projector fails.

Attachments: agenda_v3.pdf, av_checklist.xlsx, rehearsal_slots.csv

Can you confirm: headcount for Thu 19, whether you want recording turned on, and any visitor badge requirements?

Thanks — I'll coordinate with Rishi for the rehearsal script and Ben for on-site logistics.

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales Lead, Redwood Inference

Thanks all —

If we move to Fri 20 (09:00–12:00 PT) we can still run the same script — only tweak is earlier start for the ramp. My notes below: 

Recording & data handling - We can disable Redwood-side recording; that's an Ops toggle on the session. For prompts that include sensitive fields, we recommend either redaction prior to the run or using a short masking script (we can provide a small helper that replaces PII with placeholders).

Load test / rehearsal plan (proposed)
- 09:00–09:20 — warm up environment, KV cache priming (low-concurrency probes)
- 09:20–09:45 — prompt walk-through + routing sanity checks (handful of edge prompts)
- 09:45–10:30 — staged ramp: 5min @ 5 rps -> 10min @ 20 rps -> 20min @ 50 rps (stop on errors)
- 10:30–11:00 — latency/trace review, rollbacks if regression seen

AV failover options
1) Secondary laptop with capture card + USB mic (on-site engineer can switch to this in ~3 minutes).
2) Remote Zoom-hosted stream from our engineer (if the room network is flaky). Zoom link should be pre-provisioned and tested.

I'll attach the runbook and a short script for redaction: runbook_v1.md (high-level), plus a tiny masking script we can drop into your test harness.

Ben — can you confirm room AV kit and whether the AV team will allow the capture-card fallback?

—
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
